# Monolingual Corpora — Metrics Comparison (Before vs. After Cleaning)

This document provides a detailed comparison of dataset metrics measured before (raw) and after (cleaned and shrunken) the execution of the processing pipelines.

---

## 1. Metrics Defined

* **Document Count**: The number of unique JSON lines (instances) in the corpus.
* **Word Count**: The total number of space-separated strings.
* **Token Count**: The total number of subword tokens generated by our trained 16K BPE model.
* **Character Count**: The total length of the raw text strings (including characters, combining diacritics, punctuation, and whitespaces).
* **Whitespace Count**: The count of whitespace characters (` `, `\t`, `\n`).
* **Average Document Length**: The mean number of words per document instance (`Word Count / Document Count`).
* **Average Characters per Token**: The ratio of total characters to total tokens (`Character Count / Token Count`).
* **Disk Size**: The physical file storage footprint on disk in Gigabytes (GB).

---

## 2. Devanagari (Nepali) Dataset Metrics

For Nepali, the cleaning pipeline stripped out duplicate texts, garbage encoding lines, non-Devanagari text blocks, and then downsampled public sources to cap the total words at $\approx 400$ Million.

| Metric | Raw (Before Cleaning) | Cleaned \& Shrunken (After) | Change (\%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Document Count** | 19,499,682 | 6,948,683 | -64.36% |
| **Word Count** | 1,005.01M | 399.73M | -60.22% |
| **Token Count** | ~1,906.5M | **758.80M** | -60.20% |
| **Character Count** | ~6,440.0M | 2,562.17M | -60.21% |
| **Whitespace Count** | ~985.0M | 391.90M | -60.21% |
| **Avg. Document Length** | 51.5 words | 57.5 words | +11.65% |
| **Avg. Chars per Token** | ~3.38 | **3.38** | 0.00% |
| **Disk Size** | ~17.50 GB | 7.13 GB | -59.25% |

### Manual vs. Public Token Split (Nepali)
* **Manual Tokens**: **189.85 Million tokens** (**25.0%** of total) — exceeds the minimum **20% manual collection** requirement.
* **Public Tokens**: **568.95 Million tokens** (75.0% of total).

---

## 3. Telugu Dataset Metrics

For Telugu, the pipeline had to handle highly agglutinative words and extensive OCR scanning anomalies, filtering out public dumps to meet the 400M word cap.

| Metric | Raw (Before Cleaning) | Cleaned \& Shrunken (After) | Change (\%) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Document Count** | 12,499,667 | 5,880,337 | -52.95% |
| **Word Count** | 806.18M | 400.00M | -50.38% |
| **Token Count** | ~1,659.9M | **823.60M** | -50.38% |
| **Character Count** | ~6,410.0M | 3,178.94M | -50.40% |
| **Whitespace Count** | ~798.0M | 396.87M | -50.26% |
| **Avg. Document Length** | 64.5 words | 68.0 words | +5.42% |
| **Avg. Chars per Token** | ~3.86 | **3.86** | 0.00% |
| **Disk Size** | ~17.50 GB | 8.85 GB | -49.42% |

### Manual vs. Public Token Split (Telugu)
* **Manual Tokens**: **200.34 Million tokens** (**24.3%** of total) — exceeds the minimum **20% manual collection** requirement.
* **Public Tokens**: **623.26 Million tokens** (75.7% of total).
